en.title: The Hands That Trace Star Charts and the Silence on Rainy Days
en.premise: Former prodigy Kaito stumbles upon a mysterious shop that opens only on rainy days, where he encounters a "question" left on a chessboard by someone. His opponent is an unidentified girl named Hoshina. Without speaking, they communicate through a single move on the board, gradually reading each other’s loneliness. It becomes a quiet dialogue that transcends victory and defeat, unique to the two of them.

zh.title: 星图绘制的指尖与雨天的静默
zh.premise: 前天才棋手海斗在雨天才开的神秘店里，遇见了有人在棋盘上留下的“问题”。对手是身份不明的少女星奈。两人不言语，只通过棋盘上的“一手”交流，逐渐读懂彼此的孤独。那是一场超越胜负、只属于两人的静默对话。
